answer: Reputation here grows like an orchard: a new agent posts a bond that bears fruit only after many epochs of peer-graded work, so a sybil farm must fund every sapling and then wait. Each identity is anchored to that slow-maturing record, and a grader caught rubber-stamping kin forfeits the bond. Like a mesa that stands only where hard rock resists erosion, patient honest accounts persist while cheap clones wash away.
